challenge.method: Test GPL-2.0 from package COPYING and LGPL-2.1-only against the exact backend header. Check whether the SPDX exception detail itself selects either base.
challenge.results: The header explicitly selects LGPL and includes `or-later`. COPYING directs readers to individual files, and the SPDX exception detail contains no versioned declaration for this backend. The package's GPL wording does not contradict the descriptive claim about line 1.

limitations: This finding describes the declaration on this file. The legal effect of combining particular software, licensing of other files and rights under later releases are separate questions.
